paragraphs: This is Shmuel, as in [Shabbat 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.53a.8-9); see his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara asks who Aryokh is and answers “Shmuel,” as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=639&lang=en) also records.
